data.Name: Revenge of the Goose Prince
data.Description: The Goose Prince has arrived to avenge his father. Survive the honkening!
data.Template_Text: A terrifying screech — half honk, half war cry — splits the air as [Enemy1], the Goose Prince, descends upon [Location1] with an army of enraged geese. [NPC1] hides behind a barrel, screaming. You don't need to defeat this feathered fury — just survive 5 rounds of relentless pecking, wing-slapping, and psychological honking warfare!
data.2nd_state_Template_Text: You survived five rounds of [Enemy1]'s furious assault near [Location1]! The Goose Prince, exhausted and out of honks, retreats to the swamps with whatever dignity a goose can muster. [NPC1] emerges from behind the barrel, trembling but alive. Among the scattered feathers, you find a glorious prize — a crown woven from golden plumage. All hail the Goose Slayer!
